question: Which Economic Census was conducted in 2019 in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Seventh Economic Census was conducted in India in 2019
 
• The Seventh Economic Census (7th EC) was conducted in 2019-2020.
 
• Fieldwork for the census began in Tripura on July 29, 2019, and in Puducherry soon after.
 
• Fieldwork in other states and union territories began in August and September 2019.
